job: Mark or filter something by category with a small pill.
purpose: A 24px pill for categories and filters. A button tag toggles with aria-pressed; a link tag marks the current one with aria-current. A tag can hold a remove button. A tag is something people choose or apply; a badge is something that is.
useWhen: Items carry categories, topics or labels people can click to filter.
A set of applied filters or selected values can each be removed.

avoidWhen.when: A value that describes the item, such as a role or a plan.
Typing new values into a field.
Switching between views of the same data.

states.name: removable
states.how: a fd-tag-remove button inside; fires a cancelable fd:close

variants.useWhen: A tag with a faint fill and no edge, for a dense row.
A leading icon names the category.

parts.role: The button that removes a removable tag.

keyboard.does: Toggles a button tag, or removes via its remove button.
